title: AO-MA-11A Plan Approval
description: The single operator approval-gate record for the autonomous multi-AI coding workflow. Produced ONLY for a plan-consensus bundle whose unanimous_status is 'AGREE' (unanimous_status here is pinned const 'AGREE'; the validator additionally re-verifies the bound bundle recomputes to AGREE). The approval binds to the exact consensus bundle bytes (consensus_bundle_sha256), the plan (plan_digest) and the presented approval request (approval_request_sha256), so an environment-gated job can re-verify all three before proceeding. The single human gate is realized natively as a GitHub Environment ('ao-ma-plan-approval') required reviewer; this artifact records the operator's decision. Evidence only; release authority remains ao-release-gate plus the GitHub ruleset. An approval accepted via admin/bypass is invalid (bypass_detected must be false).

consensus_id.description: Foreign key to the plan-consensus bundle this approval gates.

consensus_bundle_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact consensus bundle file bytes; re-verified by the environment-gated job (Codex guardrail).

plan_digest.description: Must equal the bound bundle's plan_digest (enforced by the validator).

approval_request_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the approval request payload presented to the operator at the gate.

unanimous_status.description: Pinned const: an approval artifact exists only for a unanimous-AGREE plan. REVISE/PARTIAL/RED/missing-provider never produce an approval.

decision.description: The operator's decision at the single gate. 'approved' authorizes the autonomous run to start; 'rejected'/'expired' halt it.

environment_ref.description: The dedicated GitHub Environment whose required reviewer realizes the single human gate.

approved_by.description: Operator identity (e.g. GitHub login) recorded by the environment reviewer event.

audit_url.description: URL of the GitHub deployment/approval audit record (run/deployment URL).

bypass_detected.description: Must be false for a valid approval; an admin/bypass-accepted gate is not a valid single-gate approval.
